cards.name: Codebase Memory
cards.hint: 3D code knowledge-graph. Open via its clean `graph` tailnet name (the Open button; Google SSO). In-memory index — re-index after a restart. Opt-in: --profile codebase-memory
cards.notes: The Open link comes from SSO_ROUTES in the frontend (-> /codebase-memory/), so no `url` is needed. The health check hits the nginx subpath, which proxies through to the UI.
